collection.title: VW Transporter T5 2003 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Transporter T5 2003 to 2012 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also have the rear blade for this Transporter T5, simply click the Rear Blades tab below. Please Note - The Passenger blade listed is slightly shorter than the original.
